physicalIPhone.reason: Apple signing requires the Account Holder to accept the pending Program License Agreement

physicalAndroid.reason: First release approved using completed emulator and functional checks; physical Android measurements follow cutover

minimumOSAndAPI.reason: Declared SDK minimums have not been verified by execution at the minimum OS/API; acceptance follows cutover

startupFrameMemoryEnergy.reason: Physical-device startup, frame, memory and energy measurements and budgets follow cutover; synthetic simulator/emulator timings do not establish these budgets

firstReleasePolicy.decision: Ship using completed functional checks; finish physical-device, minimum-OS/API and performance measurements after cutover

requiredBeforeProductCutover: Successful release.yml workflow_dispatch at the exact artifact source
Actual tagged Swift Package resolution and checksum-verified released XCFramework

readinessMeaning: Authorized first-release source and scope; not a claim that publication, account setup, tag preparation, physical-device or minimum-OS verification has completed
requiredBeforePublish: Successful clean public main preparation workflow at the exact release source and independently reviewed artifact hashes
Account-owner npm namespace bootstrap and trusted publisher configured for release.yml and release environment
Existing approved lightweight Swift tag at the exact prepared manifest-only commit
